notes: Japan-market page (nintendo.co.jp), model SPR-001; sold as ニンテンドー3DS LL in Japan (alias recorded). Axis mapping: Nintendo lists 縦93mm×横156mm×厚さ22mm; height=横156 (long axis), width=縦93, depth=厚さ22 — Nintendo's own label for the long axis is 'width' (横). Closed/folded state (折りたたみ時), also the source for hinge.type=clamshell; open state not published. Nintendo gives whole millimetres here; no precision added. TOP SCREEN / AUTOSTEREOSCOPIC 3D: recorded literally as Nintendo states it — 横800ドット×縦240ドット = [800,240], aspect 10:3, with Nintendo's own gloss on the same line that the 800 horizontal dots are split 400 per eye, so the per-eye image is 400x240 (5:3). ACTIVE AREA IS PUBLISHED, NOT DERIVED: Nintendo prints the active area in millimetres inline with each diagonal, so 'derived' is deliberately FALSE — these are quoted, not computed. The 3DS XL and the New 3DS XL share identical published panel sizes and active areas (4.88型 106.2x63.72 top, 4.18型 84.96x63.72 bottom); this is what Nintendo publishes on both pages, not a value carried across models. refresh_hz, materials, corner_radius, depth_at_hinge: not published, null. controls[].position null — placement not stated; the 3D depth slider, HOME button and power button are listed by Nintendo under その他入力 with no matching enum kind. ports: game card slot, FULL-SIZE SD card slot, charging terminal and AC adapter connector omitted (no matching enum kind; not microSD); Nintendo does not state the headphone jack's 3.5 mm diameter. released = Japan launch; other regions not sourced from a Nintendo page. announced: not sourced, null.
